about.en: A Chinese starter for s2 and adult readers (P27a, C4.4), taught through Dari and Pashto: characters, pinyin with tone marks, and each tone drawn as a small line. A first three lessons as drafts (about ten to come). Words and pinyin checked against CC-CEDICT, so the pack is CC BY-SA and holds no NC item. It stays a draft until a native Mandarin speaker records every word and tone; the Dari and Pashto lines are drafts for native speakers.
